c74object.name: ease.xfade
c74object.digest: Use an easing function to interpolate between successive lists
c74object.description: Use an easing function to interpolate between successive lists.

objarg.name: input_range[low]
objarg.digest: Initial low value for the input range
objarg.description: Initial low value for the input range.

objarg.name: input_range[high]
objarg.digest: Initial high value for the input range
objarg.description: Initial high value for the input range.

objarg.name: output_range[low]
objarg.digest: Initial low value for the output range
objarg.description: Initial low value for the output range.

objarg.name: output_range[high]
objarg.digest: Initial high value for the output range
objarg.description: Initial high value for the output range.

attribute.name: output_range
attribute.digest: Expected numeric range for the output
attribute.description: Expected numeric range for the output.

attribute.name: input_range
attribute.digest: Expected numeric range for the input
attribute.description: Expected numeric range for the input.

attribute.name: function
attribute.digest: Easing function to be applied or generated
attribute.description: Easing function to be applied or generated.

attribute.name: amount
attribute.digest: Mix between linear and the easing function
attribute.description: Mix between a linear mapping (0) and the easing function (1). Values are clamped to the range 0 to 1. The default is 1.

attribute.name: clip
attribute.digest: Constrain the output to the output range
attribute.description: When enabled, the output is constrained to the output_range, so easing functions that overshoot (such as the back and elastic functions) and inputs outside the input_range do not exceed it. The default is 0 (off).
